blind_spots_patched: The baseline dossier referenced generic U.S. tariff uncertainty without dissecting the actual dual-layer tariff regime hitting GNA's North American exports (18% of FY26 sales per Nov 13 ICRA): existing 25% Section 232 medium/heavy-duty truck-part tariffs (effective Nov 1, 2025) plus USTR's November 25, 2026 Section 301 proposal of up to 25% tariffs on Indian goods (17% with a bilateral deal) while Mexico escaped Section 301 determinations.

The baseline dossier noted only that Maninder Singh Seehra trimmed shares and claimed his rationale was undisclosed—omitting promoter share pledges (5.49% / 13.80 lakh shares), Maninder Singh Seehra's complete 100% exit on September 29, 2026, Harjinder Kaur's open-market sale, the 2024 Memorandum of Family Settlement context separating GNA Axles from unlisted GNA Gears, and FY26 reporting/committee control lapses.

Baseline ch-6 erroneously stated Q2 FY27 receivables/DSO were undisclosed and extrapolated FY26's payable-boosted 107% CFO/EBITDA without auditing H1 FY27 working-capital absorption, Other Liabilities swelling, Q2 cost inflation, and two auditor-unreviewed dormant subsidiaries.

The baseline competitive analysis underestimated domestic axle-shaft rival Kross Limited's aggressive robotic forging and backward integration, overlooked GNA's indirect tiering into European truck OEMs like Scania via Cummins, and omitted Mexican near-shore forging competitiveness.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: H1 FY27 export rebound (+37% Q1, +50% Q2 YoY) signals a broad, sustained North American Class 8 truck recovery.
WEAKENED: Q2 FY27 receivables/DSO were undisclosed in public filings, and FY26's 107% CFO/EBITDA demonstrates smooth cash conversion during growth.
CONFIRMED: GNA maintains an [ICRA]AA- (Stable) balance sheet with low leverage (<1.0x Debt/OPBDIT), 15%+ operating margins, and self-funded Rs 100-125 Cr annual capex.
CONFIRMED: SUV/light-vehicle and EV-allied shafts are scaling past Rs 240 Cr run-rate alongside Rs 80 Cr EV capex and expanded plant capacity.
